title: Sarkari Haraju
desc: A man gets into a conflict with a powerful politician after he tries to retrieve a large sum of money that he has given to his fraudulent lover, who happens to be the latter's daughter.

title: Badava Rascal
desc: Shankar, a young man, is kidnapped by a gang of thugs. In order to escape his predicament, he narrates his life story to make his abductors rethink their decision.

title: Varsha
desc: After his mother's death and father's arrest, Sathya brings up his seven sisters like a father. But a villainous character from his father's past turns the siblings against each other.

title: Sampathige Saval
desc: Siddappa, a cruel landlord, refuses to pay the funeral expenses of his servant after his accidental death. Angered by the betrayal, the worker's son, Veerabhadra, grows up to resent Siddappa.

title: Bahubali 2: The Conclusion
desc: After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.
